install_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export NONINTERACTIVE=1
export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export USER="${USER:-root}"

echo "==> Installing Homebrew (https://brew.sh/)"

if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
  apt-get update -y || true
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential procps curl file git ca-certificates || true
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf -y groupinstall "Development Tools" || true
  dnf -y install procps-ng curl file git || true
fi

if ! command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
fi

for prefix in /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew /opt/homebrew /usr/local; do
  if [ -x "$prefix/bin/brew" ]; then
    eval "$("$prefix/bin/brew" shellenv)"
    break
  fi
done

install -d -m 755 /etc/profile.d
cat >/etc/profile.d/homebrew.sh <<'EOF'
for prefix in /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew /opt/homebrew /usr/local; do
  if [ -x "$prefix/bin/brew" ]; then
    eval "$("$prefix/bin/brew" shellenv)"
    break
  fi
done
EOF
chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/homebrew.sh

if ! command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: brew not found after install" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "==> $(brew --version | head -n1)"
echo "==> Homebrew installed (https://brew.sh/)"
uninstall_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
echo "==> Uninstalling Homebrew"
export NONINTERACTIVE=1
for prefix in /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew /opt/homebrew /usr/local; do
  if [ -x "$prefix/bin/brew" ]; then
    /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/uninstall.sh)" || true
    break
  fi
done
rm -f /etc/profile.d/homebrew.sh
rm -rf /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew || true
echo "==> Homebrew removed"
upgrade_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export NONINTERACTIVE=1
for prefix in /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew /opt/homebrew /usr/local; do
  if [ -x "$prefix/bin/brew" ]; then
    eval "$("$prefix/bin/brew" shellenv)"
    break
  fi
done
brew update
brew upgrade || true
echo "==> $(brew --version | head -n1)"
